title: Pepperstone Crypto: $300 Cashback on First Trade above $500 @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: Pepperstone Crypto: $300 Cashback on First Trade above $500 @ ShopBack

[stonecold] Not sure, I did it immediately.
Deposited from ING with Pay ID no issues.
Just make sure the bank account is in your name.
Some other banks apparently delay the first payment.
[txb] Did not track for me for the 250 offer and an in claim jail for the next god knows x months
[linkser] Yep, same thing last week. It tracked the click but after 2 days on the shopback app it said no purchase found.
At least still in plus, got like 12 aud in btc today as part of a signup promo.
[cwlaualex] Banks are likely to hold the transfer for a new payee. How to make it through within 3 hours?
[stonecold] ING worked no problems.
For me and my SO.
[BarginBandit] ANZ online banking is now locked for me due to the PAYID request.
Can't access it at all. Need to contact them to get it fixed.
[WoodYouLikeSomeCash] Check the terms/conditions of your bank, some like AMP Bank GO explicitly define trading crypto as a breach and therefore leads to instant shutdown.
[BarginBandit] It was fine, I spoke with them and they just wanted to know if I was acting on my own accord and wasn't doing this on behalf of someone asking me to do the transfer (as in a scammer).
It was over an hour wait though to get through, and the lady confirmed that they have had a heap of these tonight.
[cwlaualex] @BarginBandit: My transfer is still stuck.
[hola011] macquarie, ing seem to be better than any big4 banks
[Aceunreal] I used CBA with Pay ID and the funds were received within 2 minutes.
[caasi] it tracked as $0 for me, is it the same for everyone?
[stonecold] Give it about 30 minutes. Another tracking will come up with the $300.
[Sblogz] Is this for new users only or first trade that is above $500?
[ne-us] Do you have to pay CGT on the $300 cashback?
[RTX9090Ti] You can still declare it as an income and donate to NDIS or Aukus and no one will complain.
[ilovefullprice] Damn should have waited. Was on early and only got $150 bonus
[xiongnemo] The link to the deal on SB page seems to be a 404, I clicked on that "returning to homepage" or something like this and registered
When registering, SB aff code was prefilled (seems cookies are there) on the page
Done a transaction (A$510 worth of USDT) at 21.30
Still not tracked yet
[dealsgrabber] I got the same error as well. Why aren't others getting the same error? At what stage was the SB aff code prefilled?
Also, please let me know if yours tracked as I don't want to take the risk of going back to the home page after the error and then registering.
[xiongnemo] Don't quite know why. It was prefilled when I tried to register (there's an aff code input box and I saw something like aff-shopback immediately)
Still not tracked yet.
[dealsgrabber] Strange no one else reporting this error except you and me.
[xiongnemo] @dealsgrabber: Looks there's a third one here
[stonecold] Check your cashback. When a lot of us did the $250 cashback deal there was no email or notification, it just came up.
[xiongnemo] @stonecold: Thanks, I'm a first-time SB user, and I checked:
Cashback in - nothing except the A$20 referral promotion;
Shopping History - some "Pepperstone Crypto, Checking for Cashback until 2026-10-28"
So maybe just wait…
[dealsgrabber] @stonecold: I am not referring to the notification. When I click on the Pepperstone Show Now button, it goes to the 404 page. That is the issue.
[stonecold] @dealsgrabber: Try a different connection like 5G
[dealsgrabber] @stonecold: I believe people are having issues when signing up via mobile hence I was trying using desktop.
Login to Shopback, navigate to Pepperstone page on Shopback, click on Shop Now, goes to Pepperstone website with 404 error
[stonecold] @dealsgrabber: Not sure sorry, I did the previous offer on mobile.
[xiongnemo] @stonecold: I was on an Enterprise Wi-Fi for this, so I thought it might work;
But it's the same as when I use my mobile hotspot…
[rubenastley] Same issue for me. Tried on both chrome and edge.
[rubenastley] Ok seems to work now. I uninstalled adblock (instead of pausing) and selected the second 'Shop now' underneath 'More deals for you'.
[rubenastley] @xiongnemo: Tracked at $0. Still hasn't updated.
[whyisave] @rubenastley: After signing up and only buying $501 worth of a stable-coin [USDT], between 11:20 - 11:55pm AEDT,
mine says:
Tracked & cashback confirmation by 20 DEC 2026.
[hola011] had same issue on PC/mac, try on phone should work better
[M123321] Can we sell immediately after a trade and still be eligible for cashback? Anyone tried that?
[ozy] I executed a buy and sell (2 trades) and got confirmation of cashback
[WadeTheToasted] same 510 on 21.57, waiting to be tracked
[Merlict] When I'm 'buying' USDT it's the Convert option, right?
[Increase1] Same, let me know if it changes for you! Please and thank you
[ozy] Signed up this deal, bank transferred $530 (ing) nothing came through after 20mins.
Deposited again $530, this time pay id (ing) money in account 1 minute.
Immediately bought BTC $530 Aud worth.
Sold $528.81 Aud worth of BTC 8 mins later after fees.
7 mins later withdrew $529.80
1cent left in account then got an email from shopback to confirm the $300 is tracked
“ Great news! We've successfully tracked your order.
Your Cashback is currently marked as 'Pending' while we complete the validation process. Rest assured, this usually doesn't take long! We'll send you another update the moment your Cashback is confirmed and ready for you to redeem.
Happy saving,
The ShopBack Team”
No idea who wanted my data that bad but they have it now,..in return for $300
Cheers OP!
[Increase1] Do you mind checking what the eligible purchase amount is, within shopback?
[ozy] Only annoying part is my original $530 floating between the bank and them for a day or two before it gets sent back 😂
[xiongnemo] Thanks ozy!
Just want to know what happened after you clicked that "Shop Now" button from SB. Did it transfer you to the Pepperstone Crypto directly without any error?
[ozy] Yes but i’m on my iphone.
It opened the App Store where i downloaded the app.
After it installed I clicked the SB link again and this time it opened the app and signed up, it flashed a code related to shopback (moved to fast) in a referral window instantly, then asked for all my details.
Verified Id
Deposited and the rest is above
[4Flowers] I wish I understood this :(. Nice find OP.
[OzBMate629] What's so hard to understand? I can answer any questions or confusion you might have.
[logisync] Just tried now and I'm also getting 404 from shopback link. Not sure on taking the risk on proceeding when there is only just over 1hour left.
[whyisave] @logisync | @xiongnemo | @dealsgrabber
11:15pm AEDT, and I am also getting the "404" error page, from the Shop Now link on Shopback.
[dealsgrabber] There are another two Shop Now buttons below that. Use the second one from that and it works. Just used it few minutes ago and it worked for me.
[whyisave] Thanks for that !
I was using the first one, but now, the second link worked.
[whyisave] Now, my next issue, is the deposit transfer, because it is my first transfer from ING-Direct, and already it's been 5-minutes, with no funds showing up.
At 11:45pm AEDT, I don't think I'm going to make it for the ca$hback …
[dealsgrabber] @whyisave: Mine went and got credited from ING via PayID instantly.
[whyisave] @dealsgrabber: Yes, PayID worked for me :)
Now, I have 2 x $501 deposits (via Bank transfer and PayID )
[whyisave] PayID worked for me.
"Trade" has been completed.
Shopback tracked, however, I don't know if buying a stablecoin constitutes a "trade".
[whyisave] @whyisave:
if buying a stablecoin constitutes a "trade".
It did.
Shopback shows my $300 amount, but pending Pepperstone confirmation by 20 DEC 2026.
[xiongnemo] @whyisave: So you "trade" another time using the second link and got that tracked?
[whyisave] @xiongnemo: The second link worked, to get me from Shopback to Pepperstone.
Then, I made the account.
Deposited money via PayID.
Bought a stable-coin (all before 11:59pm, Monday 26/10).
Shopback showed the $300 cashback had tracked, however Pepperstone would make the final decision by 20 DEC 2026.
[xiongnemo] @whyisave: Got this; I will give it another try (as I've already traded). Thanks!
[whyisave] @xiongnemo: Here's my edited comment from before, below:
↓↓↓
The second link worked, to get me from Shopback to Pepperstone.
Then, I made the account.
Deposited money via PayID.
"Trade" = Bought a stable-coin.
The sign-up, $ deposit and "trade", were all done before 11:59pm, Monday 26/10.
Shopback showed the $300 cashback had tracked, however Pepperstone would make the final decision by 20 DEC 2026.
By the way, this Pepperstone promotion has been extended to finish by 11:59pm AEDT, Tuesday 27/10.
[xiongnemo] @whyisave: Just submit another "trade" and we'll wait…
Thanks for the edit :)
[U30004] Would have to declare this trade in the tax return. Accountant will charge extra for doing so
[whyisave] Only selling triggers the CGT event, for declaration in current financial year's tax return, ie. 2026-2027.
[thebradster48] Went back into app, signed up, deposit and trade. Been one hour and it hasn’t even tracked $0 yet. Is this going to be rejected to go into the abyss of a review now? Trying to work out what I did wrong
[whyisave] Yes, but now, it depends on Pepperstone determining whether the cashback satisfies the "trading" definition.
I'm waiting for this too.
[wigglypuff] did all the steps, it’s showing tracked but it’s $0. how long until it appears or have i done it wrong
[stonecold] You should be right. Give it around 30 min and you should get $300 come up.
[lc0] How long does it take to withdraw from Pepperstone to your bank?
[lc0] yea thought itd be instant but still hasnt gone through after 15 mins, via ubank payid
[Ksavshs] Got mine tracked in 10 minutes..
I used revolut to send money, received instantly
Bought bitcoin on spot
[inverse of zero] Constant 404 errors via laptop, and then via Android, app wouldn't send verification SMS. Oh well, it was worth a shot, unfortunately only saw this in the last hour 😔
[Oegihpmas] I guess they stopped it themselves, everything went through fine from my bank however pepperstone reviewing the deposit, I've been waiting 25min.
"We've received your deposit of 530.00 AUD and it's currently being reviewed as part of our standard checks before it's credited to your account.
Here are your deposit details:
We'll email you again once this review is complete. No action is needed from you right now.
If there's anything we can help you with, get in touch with us at support@pcrypto.com"
